chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ali ibn Atiyya, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
The dawn is that which, when you see it extending horizontally, resembles the whiteness of the Milky Way.

key_terms.الْفَجْرُ: Dawn, the time of day marking the beginning of the fast
key_terms.بَيَاضُ سُورَى: The whiteness of the Milky Way, used as a simile for the color and nature of dawn light
key_terms.مُعْتَرِضاً: Extending horizontally or crossing the sky

ai.seo_question: How to identify the exact time of dawn for fasting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the precise visual definition of 'true dawn' (al-fajr al-sadiq) by describing its horizontal, Milky Way-like appearance, distinguishing it from the vertical glow of false dawn. This criterion is essential in Shia fiqh for determining the exact onset of the fasting period, ensuring that the pre-dawn meal (suhoor) concludes at the correct astronomical moment.
